title: NYC Subway Routes and Stops
text: Spatial tabular data describing New York City subway system, derived MTA’s GTFS feed. Includes route shapes, stops, parent stations, directional platforms, transfers, pre-computed offset versions routes stops suitable schematic mapping.

title: NYC Subway Routes and Stops
text: quick map subway system, coloring route MTA brand color marking parent stations:
code: ggplot() +   geom_sf(     data = nyc_subway_routes_sf,     mapping = aes(color = route_color),     linewidth = 0.4,     alpha = 0.8   ) +   geom_sf(     data = nyc_subway_stops_parent_sf,     size = 0.3,     color = "grey20"   ) +   scale_color_identity() +   labs(     title = "NYC subway routes and stations",     caption = "Source: MTA GTFS feed"   ) +   theme_void() #> Warning: Removed 110 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range #> (`geom_sf()`).

title: NYC subway routes — nyc_subway_routes_df
text: Tabular metadata 29 named subway services MTA GTFS feed, including long short names, descriptions, brand colors, sort order.

title: NYC subway routes — nyc_subway_routes_df
text: tibble 29 rows 10 columns: route_id GTFS route identifier (e.g., "", "FX"). agency_id GTFS agency identifier ("MTA NYCT"). route_short_name Short service name, usually bullet letter number shown signage. route_long_name Descriptive long name (e.g., "8 Avenue Express"). route_desc Long-form description service. route_type GTFS route type code. Always 1 (subway/metro). route_url MTA route information URL. route_color Brand color hex string prefixed #. route_text_color Text color labels hex string prefixed #. route_sort_order MTA-supplied sort order presentation.

title: NYC subway stops — nyc_subway_stops_sf
text: simple feature collection 1,488 rows 5 columns: stop_id GTFS stop identifier. Parent stations use bare id (e.g., "101"); directional platforms append N S (e.g., "101N", "101S"). stop_name Human-readable station platform name. location_type GTFS location type. 1 indicates parent station; NA indicates directional platform (child stop). parent_station platforms, stop_id parent station; NA parent stations . geometry Point geometry EPSG:2263.
